_meta.why: Stop conflating Homey productId, Zigbee modelId, internal pid shorthand, and catalog productName. Pairing identity is always manufacturerName + productId.

pairingIdentity.doctrine: Sacred couple — Homey matches drivers ONLY on these two compose fields (SDK3)

manufacturerName.notes: Athom Developer Tools Nodes table → Manufacturer column → compose manufacturerName

productId.homeyDocQuote: Model ID: This is the productId you should include in your driver's manifest.
productId.notes: Homey renamed Zigbee modelId → productId in the app manifest. Same string value.

modelId.notes: Never invent. Interview modelId MUST be copied into zigbee.productId[]. Z2M uses model / modelID similarly.

pid.layer: Internal shorthand (this repo / CI / SSOT JSON)
pid.notes: Convenience alias only. Prefer productId in Homey-facing docs; pid OK in machine JSON (sacred-keep, gates).

productName.layer: Catalog / marketing / CSA / Tuya Cloud WiFi
productName.notes: Human-readable aliases (e.g. 'SH-SC07', 'ERS-10', brand strings). NEVER use as zigbee.productId for pairing. mfs_db.modelIds stay real Zigbee ids; productNames hold aliases (P2434).

product_name.notes: Cloud WiFi field — not Zigbee productId. Do not write into zb_model_id.

johanBendz.same: driver.compose.json uses manufacturerName + ProductId/productId from interview
johanBendz.note: Johan templates instruct: change ProductId from interview Model ID

settingsKeys.whySnake: Homey settings keys are snake_case; camelCase zb_modelId / zb_manufacturerName are FORBIDDEN bugs

workedExamples.note: P2434: brand may also appear as productId case form for broken interviews; real type via ZG-* pid; productNames hold HOBEIAN aliases

workedExamples.never: Do not invent TS0201 from productName/climate SKU
